thread:
ana: Found an anonymous-read S3 object in integrations-artifacts that contains a base64 blob labeled as a vault snapshot. URL: http://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/integrations-artifacts/2026-03-21/vault_snap.enc?region=us-west-2 :grimacing:

leo: Can you paste the S3 ACL + bucket policy snapshot? Need to know how public ACL was applied.

ana: (typo) ana: ACL: public-read on object. Bucket has no block-public-acls enabled. Object owner: integrations-ci@redwood.

rachel: If it's a vault snapshot wrapped with our staging CMK, treat it as high risk. Assume access to ciphertext + ability to attempt unwrap if key compromise.

devops-bot: Automated check: object checksum matches recent CI artifact job 2026-03-21T02:12:10Z from integrations-runner-7. Job meta: uses role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/integrations-ci-runner.

ana: I just copied the object to s3://redwood-security-evidence/4412361234/vault_snap.enc and froze the original by applying a deny put object ACL tag.

security-bot: Created INC-2320. Notifying oncall and security pager.

pager: Oncall received. Standby for triage call if needed.

leo: Short triage checklist: 1) CloudTrail: who put public ACL? 2) KMS Decrypt calls against staging CMK in last 24h 3) Inventory staging tokens & long-lived roles 4) Block further public ACLs via bucket policy and account S3 Block Public Access

rachel: I'll list Vault-sensitive artifacts that require rotation: unseal keys, root tokens, any stored long-lived service tokens captured in snapshot. Also look for transit-keys metadata in snapshot.

ana: CloudTrail event shows PutObjectAcl at 02:13:05 UTC by integrations-ci-runner role. No external principal used PutObjectAcl.

leo: Good — still internal but ACL mistake is the issue. We need to enforce policy: deny PutObjectAcl when principal != infra-admin. I can open the infra PR. Suggested policy snippet to deny public ACLs on bucket:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Principal": "*",
  "Action": "s3:PutObjectAcl",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::integrations-artifacts/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"s3:x-amz-acl": "public-read"}
  }
}
```

rachel: Also enable bucket-level ownership and BlockPublicAcls. That prevents CI from continuing to accidentally publish public objects.

leo: On KMS: no Decrypt calls from outside account. Only staging build nodes attempted Decrypt at 02:14:10 and failed with AccessDenied (because artifact was copied not unwrapped). Still we will rotate. Plan: create new CMK, alias swap, then rewrap backups we care about. Eli? (Eli not in thread)

ana: I've notified integrations team and asked them to revoke the runner's short-term creds and re-run the pipeline with corrected artifact step. They acked and created a changelist.

security-bot: CloudTrail query for KMS decrypt completed: no successful decrypts for staging-kms in last 30 days. Job ct-4412361234-1.

rachel: Ok lower immediate blast radius, but still need to rotate any long-lived tokens found in snapshot. Leo, can you add a step to rotate Vault auto-unseal binding (rekey) after we swap KMS alias? We need a scheduled 15m window so unseal agent can be restarted in a canary cluster first.

leo: Yep. Proposed timeline: (1) create CMK now and stage alias (2) schedule alias swap in 1h during low traffic (3) rotate Vault auto-unseal binding and transit key in canary host (4) rewrap retained backups and delete public copies. Will post full runbook.

legal: Please prepare a short partner notification template in case integrations relied on a third-party uploader. We may need to inform them even if keys not decrypted.

ana: I extracted the tar listing from the snapshot: 
```
$ tar -tf vault_snap.tar
data/kv/2/keys/some-service
transit/keys/transit-key-2025
core/unseal-keys.json.enc
```

rachel: That transit key age is old; rotate it. Also schedule a token revocation sweep for any long-lived tokens issued before 2026-03-01.

leo: PR opened to enforce bucket policy + account block public ACLs: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/2210. Added a pre-commit check to the integrations pipeline that prevents s3 acl public-read values.

security-bot: Incident INC-2320 updated with runbook link.

ana: Post-action checklist I'm tracking: copy object (done), enable logging on integrations-artifacts bucket (in progress), revoke runners (done), create CMK (done), schedule alias swap (pending), rotate transit key (pending), run token revocation (pending), postmortem owner: rachel.

rachel: I'll own postmortem. Also capture lessons: add S3 ACL linting to CI, make vault backups write to private-only bucket by default, and surface KMS usage warnings for artifact jobs.

leo: I'll coordinate the alias swap and post run results here. Can we move discussion to #inc-2320 for step-by-step?

ana: Moving to incident channel and closing slack thread.
